title.value: A portrait of the different configurations between digitally-enabled innovations and climate governance
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: A portrait of the different configurations between digitally-enabled innovations and climate governance

extractions.description: This paper explores the potential of digital technologies to transform climate governance. It categorizes strategies employed by digitally-enabled initiatives and analyzes their connections to the Earth System Governance framework.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on climate governance and the role of digital technologies in achieving climate mitigation goals, which are central to sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: There is increasing recognition that rapid and far-reaching societal transformations will be necessary to keep global average temperature rise well below 2 ^{◦} C

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily focuses on initiatives aimed at mitigating climate change through digital technologies.
primary_category.quote: In this paper, we seek to explore the potential of transformations in and of governance regimes. We know that climate mitigation governance has thus far not been able to effectively address the scale of the climate crisis

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper analyzes and categorizes different strategies for influencing climate governance and promotes connections among them, within and between regions.
primary_sub_category.quote: The goal of this paper is to spark discussions and further investigations into how digitally-enabled ini­tiatives may actually re-shape climate governance. In addition, we hope that this showcase of inspiring initiatives will promote more connections among them, within and between regions
